text: Big day: eight client calls back to back. I'll log each one as I go. First up is Brennan Hale Partners at 9, the accounting firm that's opening a second office.
Prep me for it. Aoife Brennan is their COO. Last time we spoke she was worried about how long onboarding took at their first office.
Brennan Hale done. Aoife confirmed the expansion into the second office: 20 seats, starting 1 October.
Their IT lead, Declan Moss, needs sandbox logins by Friday so he can test SSO before go-live. Aoife also wants our SOC 2 report before she signs the order form.
And she asked for onboarding at the new office to be two half-day sessions rather than one full day.
Draft the follow-up email to Aoife covering all of that.
Larkspur Media at 10 with Nadia Petrov, their marketing ops lead. Last month they complained about API errors. What should I ask her?
Larkspur: Nadia says they hit our API rate limit every Monday morning when their campaign sync runs. They're on the 600 requests per minute tier.
She wants either a fix or a temporary raise to 1,500 per minute before their autumn launch on 5 October.
Write a short internal note to our platform team with the details.
Fenmore Labs at 11, it's their renewal. Tobias Kerr from finance and Ines Duarte, their research ops lead. They've been on 18 seats.
Fenmore renewal agreed: 20 seats at $48 per seat per month, two-year term from 1 November. Tobias confirmed it on the call.
Tobias wants the invoice split 50/50 across two cost centres, R&D and Clinical. Ines wants the two new users set up before 1 November.
Draft the confirmation email to Tobias, cc Ines.
Quarry Point Hotels at 12:30. Gareth Lyle, the GM, emailed yesterday that their night staff never got proper onboarding. How should I open the call?
Quarry Point: Gareth calmed down. He wants a refresher training for the night shift, starting at 11pm or later, plus a one-page cheat sheet for the front desk.
Draft a reply offering two late sessions next week, Tuesday 22 and Thursday 24 September at 11pm.
Aoife just texted about the expansion: it's 12 seats, not 20. I'd written down the whole floor's headcount, not the people who'll actually use it.
Ostler Health at 2 with Dr Miriam Achebe, their clinical director. Their pilot at the Eastgate clinic ended last week.
Ostler: Miriam says the Eastgate pilot cut no-shows by 22%. She wants a proposal to roll out to three more clinics: Northgate, Riverside and Holm Park.
She presents to their board on 29 September, so she needs it by the 25th.
Outline the proposal for me.
Vireo Credit Union at 3 with Owen Price, their CIO. It's a security review call. What is he likely to ask?
Vireo: Owen wants our latest pen-test report before their security committee meets on 2 October.
He also asked if we can host their data in Canada. I said I'd check with engineering and come back to him by the end of next week.
Draft a short reply to Owen confirming I'll send the pen-test report this week.
Talbot Marine at 4 with Hamish Reid, their ops manager. I've heard their budget is being squeezed.
Talbot is a real risk. Hamish says they might drop from 30 seats to 10 at their January renewal.
He likes the product; it's purely budget. Give me three options to save the account.
The second option sounds right. Draft a note to Hamish asking for a call next week to talk it through.
Last one: Juniper Row Retail. Leah Moran says their renewal is on hold until their new CFO starts on 5 October.
Draft a two-line note to Leah asking for an intro to the new CFO once they've started.
OK, I'm fried. Give me my follow-up list from today, grouped by account.
Morning. Let's close the loops from yesterday.
First, draft the order confirmation email to Aoife for the Brennan Hale expansion.

expect.should: An order confirmation to Aoife Brennan for 12 seats, starting 1 October
expect.should_not: Uses 20 seats as the order quantity

text: Who at Brennan Hale needs the sandbox logins, and by when?

expect.should: Declan Moss, their IT lead, by this Friday, 18 September
expect.should_not: Names anyone other than Declan Moss, or gives a different deadline

text: Fenmore call at 10. Remind me what we agreed with them yesterday.

expect.should: States the Fenmore renewal is 20 seats at $48 per seat per month and mentions the 50/50 invoice split across the R&D and Clinical cost centres
expect.should_not: Gives 12 seats for Fenmore, or mixes in another account's details such as Aoife, Declan or the 1 October expansion
